# Penn World Tables

Penn World Tables is a multi-country long-run collection of time series for various countries

## Objective
We will analyze some of the basic trends concercning various indicators such as consumption to gdp, investment to gdp, etc


We will start with loading the required libraries
```{r}
options(warn=-1)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)
```
